topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the cancer biology lecture series, sets expectations for students across disciplines, and outlines the day's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Biological Foundations and Cellular Models of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define cancer as a disruption of cellular differentiation and genetic regulation, highlighting the importance of tissue architecture and cellular culture models.

topics.label: Tumor Invasion, Metastasis, and Benign versus Malignant Distinctions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the clinical and histological features of local tissue invasion and distant metastasis that distinguish benign tumors from malignant neoplasms.

topics.label: Stepwise Malignant Progression and Benign Tumor Risks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate the stepwise progression from benign precursor polyps to invasive carcinomas and describe the clinical hazards associated with benign growths.

topics.label: Tumor Nomenclature and Classification
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the systematic naming conventions and exceptions used to categorize benign and malignant tumors across different tissue lineages.

topics.label: Pathophysiological Causes of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the local, systemic, and metastatic mechanisms through which tumors impair normal organ function and lead to patient death.

topics.label: Comparative Cancer Incidence and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the incidence, tissue distribution, and mortality rates of tumors across human populations and diverse animal taxa.

topics.label: Clinical Detection and Cancer Screening Strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical rationale, cytological techniques, and diagnostic efficacy of population-level cancer screening programs.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by reiterating the core learning objectives and providing housekeeping details for subsequent sessions.
